correctness.rationale: Using Bevan interpretation truth I|=Box(psi) iff Gamma proves_(L_(n-1)) psi, and L_j⊂K from representing any Kripke point by an interpretation whose Gamma is the successor theory, the induction is sound. For finite Sigma modal depth<=n collect box operands B of depth<=n-1; partition by Gamma derivability. For each chi in negative B, K-satisfiability of (and B+) and not chi follows because a K proof of (and B+)→chi, of depth<=n-1, would be an L_(n-1) theorem under induction, contradicting nonderivability. FMP and finite-depth unraveling yield a finite height<=n-1 witness for every negative chi. Attach these as successors of a root with I atomic valuation, matching all target boxes/Boolean combinations and producing height<=n. For n=0 PC equals K depth-zero tautologies; hence L_n and K have equal depth-n fragments. Empty-Gamma witnesses show Box^(n+1)top not in L_n, while theorem-lifting puts it in L_(n+1). Bevan Proposition 5 and fixed-point/necessitation closure give union=L_omega=K and strictness until omega. No finite enumeration or proof logs are represented as a universal certificate.

originality.rationale: Bevan 2025 already proves the VINT operator equation, continuity and union at the fixed point K. The audited claim separately quantifies over arbitrary interpretations and finite modal-depth formula sets, constructs bounded-height finite Kripke trees, identifies exact finite-stage modal-depth agreement and strict first omission. The union statement alone is consistent with earlier finite stabilization and does not imply exact depth. However priority against Bevan 2022 dissertation remains a material access risk.
